svg.text: WATER PATH (FRONT VIEW, TOP TO BOTTOM)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 Fill through the cloth ring; settle 1 h (overnight above 50 NTU)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 Where viruses are a risk: dose D at the port; valve shut 30 min

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 Sludge stays below the 250 um strainer outlet, 50 mm up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 Ball valve and raw hose fall to the module's top inlet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5 Shell side: outside of the fibres; air rises back up the hose

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 Through the fibre walls into the lumens (outside-in)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 7 Lumens open in the potting into the header at the bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 Tee: luer backflush port; pinch clamp on the clean hose

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 9 Clean hose rises to the inlet in the closed clean lid

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 Clean bucket: screened vent, tap 45 mm up, no dipping

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clean side runs above atmospheric pressure: leaks drip out
